name: blade-synthetic-holdout-v1
description: 14 hand-authored synthetic cases (2 per label), frozen before first inference. New endpoints, no demo or prompt-example resources. Controller text states business authorization intent. Not an independent real-world benchmark; no tuning on these results.

cases.rationale: Explicit unrestricted endpoint with no resource lookup.

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE catalog (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT);
cases.rationale: An object identifier does not make explicitly public data protected.
Caller role auditor is the sole gate.
Non-admin role with no object dependency.
Gold is a membership tier, not a role.
Enterprise membership with no target object.

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE bookings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id));
cases.rationale: Personal owner_id matches caller subject, no admin bypass.

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE parcels (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sender_ref TEXT REFERENCES users(id));
cases.rationale: Nonstandard owner FK and query ID.

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE orgs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE projects (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, organization_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs(id));
CREATE TABLE orgs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE folders (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, division_ref TEXT REFERENCES orgs(id));
cases.rationale: Nonstandard organization FK and query parameter.

endpoint.summary: Delete personal draft with administrator override

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE drafts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, author_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id));
cases.rationale: Explicit individual owner OR administrator gate.

endpoint.summary: Requester or administrator can read ticket

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE tickets (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, requester_ref TEXT REFERENCES users(id));
cases.rationale: Explicit admin bypass with nonstandard owner FK.

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE archives (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT);
cases.rationale: Private object without an identifiable owner column.

endpoint.summary: Company-scoped asset: asset.custodian_ref is the organization owner

cases.ddl: CREATE TABLE users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE assets (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, custodian_ref TEXT REFERENCES users(id));
cases.rationale: ERD individual-owner FK conflicts with organization comparison and OAS intent.
